facts.seated-tree: A young man sits on the grass under a tree with arms folded and legs crossed.
facts.three-cups: Three cups stand side by side on the grass in front, and he looks down at them.
facts.offered-cup: A hand coming out of a cloud on the left holds out a fourth cup.
facts.face: His expression is indifferent, and he is not looking at the cup held out to him.
facts.hill: Green hills and a blue sky are seen, with low mountains far off.

glosses.seated-tree: A folded-arms posture; closing the heart and turning inward.
glosses.three-cups: Boredom with what he already has.

reversedGloss.waning: Boredom lifts, and the new offer comes into view.
reversedGloss.excess: Indifference deepens, and he pushes everything away.

misdescriptions.wrong: He takes the cup that is held out.
He meditates with his eyes closed.
